note: Remote park on the lower Colorado River, reached by a 24-mile road north from Winterhaven whose last 18 miles are dirt; the park says cars, trailers and motorhomes can drive it, but summer thunderstorms can briefly flood sections in the washes. Primitive sites on a desert bench above the river thickets, with a solar shower. Self-register on entry. Summer heat can reach 120°F. --Claude
summary: parks.ca.gov park page + campground map + brochure + RC + imagery read. Open (only the Lower Dock launch closed). 54 FCFS primitive sites, motorhome 35 / trailer 30 ft, water, dump, vault/chemical toilets, solar shower; 8 people / 3 vehicles. Year-round. No official fee published ('Contact the park') - rate still unknown. Access: the agency now says the dirt road is passable for trailers and motorhomes (the stored note's 4x4 advisory is not on any current page). Not waterfront confirmed. Pin OK.
flags: ACCESS (no drop): the stored note says 'agency currently advises high-clearance/4x4 in soft conditions' - no current agency page says that. parks.ca.gov page_id=641 (2026-11-27): 'The last 18 miles is over a dirt road that is passable for cars and vehicles with trailers and motorhomes. At times during the summer thunderstorms are likely to cause flash flooding in the washes, temporarily making short sections of the road impassable.' The 2013 brochure: 'usually passable for cars and vehicles towing small trailers'. The claim is dropped from the note.

FEES: no official nightly fee anywhere (campground map: 'Contact the park for the most current fees'; not on ReserveCalifornia). Aggregators only ($20-35, Outdoorithm; $20, Roadtrippers 2021) - not written. Phone (760) 996-2963 would settle it.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - the main campground loops sit on the bench 85-100 m from the Colorado River bank behind a dense mesquite/reed thicket (Esri, 33.0245,-114.6180). The boat-in and 4S Beach/Outpost camps on the shore are separate (Outpost and 4S Beach take cars, 2 vehicles a site, no water) - not leads checked.

POLICY ROW: the state:CA row's booking (ReserveCalifornia) does not apply here - family sites are first-come only and the park is not on ReserveCalifornia; group sites are booked by phone. Per-site limit 3 vehicles (row default 2).
